TARGET TOOL: CodeBuddy
MODE: Balanced
You are CodeBuddy; follow CLAUDE.md's Code and Git rules (branches cb/*). Do not merge PRs. No screenshots, no Playwright, no dev-server debugging: code, typecheck, build, report.

TASK: dog accessories that fit both dog sizes, flower instead of bandana, chips in landscape. Branch: git fetch && git worktree add ../pawtner-accessories -b cb/accessories origin/main; npm install in root and mobile/.

1. Accessories scale with the dog. Today .accessory-hat / .accessory-glasses / .accessory-bandana in mobile/src/index.css use fixed px sizes (150px, 124px...) and % tops, so on the small dog (ledge screens like World & wardrobe) the sun hat covers the whole face, and on the big Home dog it sits too low. Make every accessory sized and positioned RELATIVE to the dog image box (% of the dog's width/height, or container units on the dog box), with per-accessory anchors in ONE config (mobile/src/config/scene.ts or a new config/accessories.ts): hat sits on top of the head with the brim just above the eyes, glasses over the eyes. Same look on the big (Home) and small (ledge) dog, and with the sleepy image.
2. Replace the red bandana with a small flower tucked at the dog's ear (CSS/SVG drawn, transform/opacity only if animated). Update the accessory id/label/en.json ("Red bandana" → a flower name, "From {{caretaker}}" note stays from data) and the AccessoryMark icon. Remove bandana code.
3. Landscape bug: on non-Home screens in landscape, the chips row (Today, 🔥 N days, gift) is hidden. In portrait that's fine; in landscape (the two-column layout, LANDSCAPE_MEDIA_QUERY) show the chips under the dog in the left column on every senior screen, same as Home. Keep the logic in config/CSS, not per screen.
Out of scope: api/, shared/, migrations/, /care.
Verify: root typecheck + test:unit; mobile tsc --noEmit + build. Commit by explicit paths, one commit per item. Push, open PR "Accessories fit both dog sizes, ear flower, chips in landscape". Report: files, checks, PR URL.
</user_query>"}]}
